labels.legal.firstRunBody: WPods is an independent, open-source project. It isn't made, sponsored, endorsed or supported by Apple. AirPods and the names of their features belong to Apple Inc.; WPods uses them only to say what it works with. WPods comes with no warranty: you use it at your own risk.
labels.legal.adapterBody: WPods' background service takes over your Bluetooth adapter and passes it back to Windows as a virtual adapter through usbip-win2 by Vadym Hrynchyshyn, so all your Bluetooth devices keep working. When you uninstall WPods, or if this keeps failing, the adapter goes back to Windows' own driver.
labels.legal.footer: Not affiliated with Apple. AirPods is a trademark of Apple Inc.
labels.legal.title: Legal
labels.legal.notAppleBody: WPods is an independent project. It isn't made, sponsored, endorsed or supported by Apple Inc.
labels.legal.trademarksBody: Apple, AirPods, AirPods Pro, AirPods Max, iPhone, iPad and Mac are trademarks of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. Feature names such as Noise Cancellation, Transparency, Adaptive, Conversation Awareness, Personalized Volume, Hearing Aid, Standard, Voice Isolation and Wide Spectrum are Apple's names. WPods uses them only to describe which AirPods and features it works with, and claims no rights to them.
labels.legal.ownFeaturesBody: Where WPods runs its own processing under one of Apple's names, like the mic modes, it is WPods' own implementation and not Apple's technology.
labels.legal.thirdPartyBody: The noise-reduction models and libraries WPods ships belong to their authors and are used under their licenses. WPods claims no ownership of them.

labels.toast.serviceDown: WPods' background service isn't running, so AirPods features are paused (error {code}). Restart your PC, or reinstall WPods if this keeps happening.
labels.toast.restartToFinish: Restart Windows to finish setting up WPods. AirPods features start after the restart.
labels.toast.bluetoothNative: WPods handed Bluetooth back to Windows after repeated problems, so AirPods features are paused (error {code}).
labels.toast.updateFailed: The update couldn't be installed (error {code}). Try again later.
labels.popup.multiSubTwo: Two of your AirPods are nearby.
labels.popup.multiSubThree: Three of your AirPods are nearby.
labels.popup.failedBody: Make sure your AirPods are close to your PC and try again.
